didactic_context_instructions: Use one sentence or paragraph before focus, bold precisely the normative central text, then one sentence or paragraph after it; include exception. anti_error: §5.4.13 allows 3 alternatives, yet each test variant includes quantifier choices; no literal unqualified 'all three correct' response.
§5.5.2.3 contains TWO conjunctive requirements: separate disconnectability and a tool; C expresses only the first, still true.
§5.2.4.6.1 thresholds are 16 Cu/25 Al for the polyphase branch, not 25 Cu/35 Al.
